lines: Manish Sharma's offer-for-sale proceeds of up to ₹6.08 crore have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 8 months ago, so the trigger is old.
Retained stake is an estimate of ₹110.73 crore at the offer price, after selling up to 45,000 shares.
Family link: Priyanka Manish Sharma appears in the seller table, which may be a relevant relationship to discuss.
Gain of up to ₹5.88 crore is before offer expenses and taxes; actual proceeds are slightly lower due to the employee discount.
